models.label: GPT-REALTIME-WHISPER
models.description: Streaming dictation — transcribes as you speak, lowest latency. Auto language only.
models.useCase: Everyday live dictation where speed matters more than peak accuracy.

models.label: GPT-4O-TRANSCRIBE
models.description: Best default accuracy for transcribing a finished recording.
models.useCase: Re-running saved audio for a clean, accurate transcript.

models.label: GPT-4O-MINI-TRANSCRIBE
models.description: Budget transcription at half the cost of GPT-4o-transcribe.
models.useCase: High-volume or cost-sensitive transcription where top accuracy isn't critical.

models.label: WHISPER-1
models.description: Whisper with word-level timestamps — the only OpenAI model that returns them.
models.useCase: When you need per-word timing, e.g. captions or alignment.

models.label: GROK SPEECH-TO-TEXT
models.description: xAI speech-to-text — does live and file, with diarization, word timestamps, multichannel and formatting (ITN).
models.useCase: Multi-speaker recordings or meetings where you want speaker labels; cheapest per-hour.

models.label: GEMINI 2.5 FLASH
models.description: Gemini multimodal transcription via prompt — not a dedicated ASR endpoint.
models.useCase: Transcribing within the Google ecosystem, or flexible prompt-based control.
